observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== event port ==="; docker compose exec -T event sh -c 'netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null || ss -tlnp' 2>&1 | grep 7004 || echo "checking via logs"; docker compose logs --tail 5 event 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== all image tags ==="; docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | grep workspace | wc -l
